artifact: Primary-text checks for the France row (Sl. no. 19) of the MCR colistin seed

primary.title: Spread of the mcr-1 colistin-resistance gene in Escherichia coli through plasmid transmission and chromosomal transposition in French goats

retrieved.note: Full published HTML fetched by this wake. The text is not mirrored here; only the quoted fragments below, each with the count of its occurrences in the stripped text.

quotes.quote: In a few cases, the expected number of samples could not be obtained, so that a total of 1,561 animals including 775 kids were sampled.
quotes.implies: the 1,561 are unique animals; breeding farms were each visited once (rectal swabs from 10 adults and 10 kids per farm)

quotes.quote: In all, over the 1,561 animals tested, 65 (4.2%) were mcr-1-positive, of which 57 were goat kids (57/775, 7.4%).
quotes.implies: breeding stratum: 65/1561 = 4.2% over unique animals; kid stratum 57/775 = 7.4%; adults 8/786 = 1.0% by subtraction

quotes.quote: The number of mcr-1-positive animals per time point varied from 3 to 10 over 10 samples, and mcr-1-positive E. coli were identified in 60.0% (84/140) of the tested animals.
quotes.implies: 140 = 14 sampling occasions x 10 samples; unique animals not stated, so the repeat-sampling caveat holds for this stratum only

quotes.quote: four fattening farms were visited, corresponding to five fattening batches (two successive batches in the same farm). Over the one-month fattening period, four batches were sampled three times [and one batch twice]
quotes.implies: 4 x 3 + 1 x 2 = 14 occasions, consistent with 140 samples; confirms the abstract/methods farm-count discrepancy the reviewed record flags

quotes.quote: in both breeding (n =80) and fattening farms (n =5)
quotes.implies: abstract counts five fattening farms; Sections 2.1 count four physical farms and five batches

quotes.quote: All 149 mcr-1-positive isolates were characterized by PCR ... In total, 46 E. coli were short-read sequenced
quotes.implies: 149 positives and 46 sequenced representatives both confirmed

quotes.quote: the mcr-1 gene was located either on the chromosome (n = 48; 48/149, 32.2%) or on the IncX4 (n = 58; 38.9%) and IncHI2 (n = 40; 26.8%) plasmids
quotes.implies: 48 + 58 + 40 = 146 of 149 located; 3 unlocated, consistent with the paper's 'could not be reliably located' note

verdicts.arithmetic_1561_plus_140_equals_1701: true (this wake recomputed it; the number 1701 does not itself appear in the primary)
verdicts.reviewed_record_49_explanation: resolved in the negative: a standalone 49 occurs zero times in the primary, so the seed's numerator has no counterpart in this paper and is not an alternative unit
